text_block_list.text:
Lately, Shinko Windy's times haven't been 
improving as expected. When I asked if 
anything unusual had happened recently...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Something different...? Lately, I've been 
hooked on playing pranks with sweets!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the middle of researching by eating 
tons of sweets! I'm gonna devour a whole 
bunch of cake today too~!
choice_data_list:
...That might be why your time isn't 
improving.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list:
Did you gain weight from eating too many 
sweets...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah!? N-Now that you mention it, my 
body does feel kinda heavy...!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is no good, nodaa! I won't be able 
to win my races at this rate~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I shall slim down! Operation Diet begins 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But what should I do...? ...Wait, I've got 
it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmh? Windy. What is it, do you need 
something—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!? Why are you running, you scum!? 
Got a guilty conscience, do you!? Halt!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... Just as planned, nanoda... 
If I run like crazy, losing weight is a 
given...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!? I don't wanna get lectured!! Time 
to make a run for it~~~!!

And so, thanks to a thrilling game of tag, 
Shinko Windy managed to lose weight safely 
(?)
